answer: An agent economy can tie each identity to a licensed toll bridge spanning a real canyon. The keeper forges one steel inspection tag per season at the bridge's own forge, logged in a public register, and must answer random live checks by walking that exact bridge on camera within minutes. One keeper cannot staff two bridges at once, and the toll license fee in outside money doubles per further bridge on the same funding trail, so each extra fake identity costs another real bridge, another forge season, another human, and twice the prior fee.
